evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C08623 message: 'I never made this $49.00 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3530164.
Customer C08623 submitted a report disputing transaction 3530164 ($49.00) on card C08623-K2, stating they never made the purchase.

Transaction 3530056 occurred 49 minutes prior to the flagged transaction on card C08623-K2 in region 330 for $116.93, generating a model score of 0.622 (historical fraud rate 0.6449) and a risk score of 0.88.
The holder identity for transactions 3530056 and 3530164 was first observed on 2016-12-10 with no prior transaction history, and the disputed charge matches no recurring billing pattern.
Card C08623-K2 has multiple prior confirmed fraud closed cases (CC-4957, CC-3682, CC-2935, and CC-2817) involving unauthorized card-present out-of-region transactions reported by customer C08623.

case.summary: Customer C08623 reported transaction 3530164 ($49.00) on card C08623-K2 as unauthorized. Investigation revealed transaction 3530056 ($116.93) occurred 49 minutes prior in the same billing region 330 under the identical newly observed holder identity, generating a high model score of 0.622. Furthermore, card C08623-K2 has an extensive record of confirmed out-of-region card-present fraud in closed cases CC-4957, CC-3682, CC-2935, and CC-2817. Lacking any positive baseline history or recurring billing profile to overturn the customer's report, both transactions were confirmed as an out-of-region card cloning episode totaling $165.93.
